Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
First things first: do you enjoy solving problems, writing clean code, and figuring out how to make things work better without making them unnecessarily complicated? If so, you might be a great fit for Seez.
Seez is an AI-powered automotive technology company transforming how vehicles are bought and sold. Since 2016, we've been building scalable SaaS and digital retail solutions that help dealerships, OEMs, and marketplaces deliver smarter, more seamless car buying experiences. We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with strong frontend capabilities, solid backend experience, and a knack for finding practical solutions to real problems.
You'll work across multiple live products, contribute to new features, improve existing applications, and collaborate closely with our Product, Design, Backend, QA, and DevOps teams. This is a great opportunity for someone who's confident in their technical abilities but still hungry to learn, take on greater ownership, and grow into a technical leadership role. We're not looking for someone who knows everything. We're looking for someone with strong foundations, good judgment, and the curiosity to keep getting better.
 Job Key Responsibilities
Technical & Engineering
Develop, maintain and improve web applications with Node.js, Vue.js and/or React
Balance new features, maintenance and improvements across multiple production applications and repositories
Work within existing architectures, design systems and shared engineering standards, extending what exists before building something new
Write clean, maintainable code and favor simple solutions over unnecessary complexity
Work with DevOps on CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery), deployments and infrastructure
Troubleshoot issues and improve performance and reliability
Product & Collaboration
Understand the business need and the client behind each feature, and turn requirements into practical implementations
Challenge assumptions constructively and suggest alternatives, including simpler scopes, when you see a better route
Balance technical quality, timelines and product priorities
Communicate clearly, exchange feedback openly, and collaborate with colleagues across different disciplines and working styles
Ownership & Growth
Take responsibility for assigned features and projects, from development through delivery and maintenance
Build confidence in making technical decisions and progressively take on more complex responsibilities
Share knowledge, contribute to team discussions, and support less experienced engineers
Seek feedback, learn from challenges, and actively contribute to improving how the team works
Develop the technical judgment, communication, and mentoring skills needed to grow into future leadership opportunities
 Requirements
 WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE PARTY (MUST HAVES)
Around 4-7 years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated experience building and maintaining production applications
Strong proficiency in Node.js, with solid expertise in either Vue.js or React and the ability to learn the other quickly
Experience working across both frontend and backend development
Experience maintaining existing products and navigating established codebases, not just building applications from scratch
Working knowledge of Jenkins, Cloudflare, AWS S3, and CI/CD workflows
Understanding of software architecture, design systems, coding standards, and engineering best practices
Good problem-solving skills and the judgment to choose practical solutions over unnecessary complexity
A collaborative mindset and the confidence to give, receive, and act on constructive feedback
An understanding of how technical decisions influence user experience and business outcomes
A willingness to adapt, take ownership, and continuously improve
 YOU'LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU'RE SOMEONE (GREAT-TO-HAVE)
Experience mentoring junior engineers or supporting technical onboarding
Experience contributing to engineering standards or process improvements
Exposure to technical planning, architectural discussions, or feature ownership
Familiarity with automotive or SaaS products
An interest in progressing toward technical or people leadership
 OUR TECH ENVIRONMENT
Backend: Node.js
Frontend: Vue.js and React
CI/CD: Jenkins
Cloud & Infrastructure: Cloudflare and AWS S3
Ways of Working: Shared engineering standards, established design systems, and cross-functional product development
 Benefits
25 days of paid annual leave plus public holidays
Flexible remote work options
Open door policy to CEO and all Leadership team
One-on-one wellness coaching sessions because your well-being matters
An annual wellness budget to fuel whatever keeps you balanced—whether that's yoga, hiking, or visit to the museum
An annual learning budget to power your growth—be it a new course, certification, or skill you've been eyeing
Regular team events, social calls, the best company SWAG, and a vibrant remote culture
 WHY JOIN SEEZ?
 At Seez, we're all about attracting and keeping top talent, the kind of people who bring ideas, energy, and curiosity to the table. We've created a space where great work gets noticed, collaboration is second nature, and our values aren't just posters on the wall; they guide everything we do.
We're a colorful mix of cultures, backgrounds, and perspectives. Everyone has a voice, a purpose, and the freedom to show up as their real self. It's the kind of place where you can do meaningful work, grow quickly, enjoy a healthy work-life balance, and shape your own career path.
